name: newsh2-153
summary: Star core panel, a square armoured flyer that fills its whole 24x28 block: a dark machinery deck framed by grey side beams, with a glowing red core in the middle under a grey armoured prow, red armour shoulders either side of the core, a red chin below it and two rust-red engine pods at the bottom around a dark central bay. Hard-surface shape language: chamfered plates, a faceted ridge and boxy pods; only the core orb is round.

concept.use: design guide; the sprite decides outline, proportions and colours

traits: glowing red orb with a yellow-orange hot centre, emissive
set in a raised dark red collar ring, standing clearly above the shoulders
orb dome about half its width tall
brightens over frames 153/155/157 (palette animation kept)
features.note: The concept reads it as a glass eye in a round housing; the sprite's brightest pixels.

traits: grey armoured prow from the top edge down to the core, widening toward the core
faceted, with a sharp crest along column 11 (bright line) and a darker right flank
rises toward the core, several px tall where it meets the collar
features.note: Upper point of the star; the concept's nose armour plate.

traits: grey beam down the left edge from row ~10 to the bottom
a hard, chamfered box about 3 px tall, with a sloped top end
features.note: Side armour frame (concept: side armour blocks).

traits: grey beam down the right edge from row ~10 to the bottom
same height and chamfer as the left beam
dark red armour block against the core collar
grey lit ledge along its lower edge (row 16)
raised, lower than the collar
features.note: Left arm of the star; the concept's shoulder plate.

traits: dark red armour block against the core collar
grey lit ledge along its lower edge (row 16)
rust-red engine pod, a chamfered block with its upper-left corner cut diagonally
brown rear section (rows 24-25)
clearly raised, about 3 px tall, hard edges
features.note: Lower-left point of the star; the concept's engine pod.

traits: rust-red engine pod with its upper-left corner cut
dark brown nozzle section at its lower end (rows 25-26)
rounded red lip right under the core, highlight band across its top (row 18)
horizontal half-cylinder, not a blob
features.note: The concept's chin block under the eye.

traits: dark bay between the pods, cut below the deck
framed by the chin above and the pods either side
features.note: Black pixels inside the silhouette are depth.

traits: small grey ball studs at (2,6) and (19,6) on dark wing plates
thin dark struts running from the studs in toward the ridge
features.note: The concept draws angled wings with ball studs and struts behind the nose.

traits: beige block top left (cols 0-5) with a beige strip along row 0
grey block top right (cols 18-24)
chamfered, about 1.5 px tall
features.note: Small beige and brown blocks also sit along the bottom edge (rows 26-28).
